ui_move.name: ui_move
ui_move.note: hover: one high sine blip and a tick of air

ui_value.name: ui_value
ui_value.note: value step: a triangle tick with a glass glint

ui_rod.name: ui_rod
ui_rod.note: rod switch: a low soft tick

ui_tab.name: ui_tab
ui_tab.note: tab: a short swish into a blip

ui_click.name: ui_click
ui_click.note: confirm: two rising glass notes with a halo

ui_back.name: ui_back
ui_back.note: back: the confirm turned down and darker

ui_open.name: ui_open
ui_open.note: panel open: air rising into a strummed glass chord

ui_error.name: ui_error
ui_error.note: denied: two flickering low buzzes, a semitone rub on purpose

ui_start.name: ui_start
ui_start.note: match start: a rising arpeggio landing on a glass bell

ui_wipe.name: ui_wipe
ui_wipe.note: screen wipe: a filtered air sweep with a faint rising glint

ball_roll_slow.name: ball_roll_slow
ball_roll_slow.note: the ball rolling slowly on the pitch: a low rumble, the board knocked by the grain, a few ticks of the shell

ball_roll_fast.name: ball_roll_fast
ball_roll_fast.note: rolling fast: brighter rumble, the board rung hard, the ball turning ~9 times a second

ball_scrape.name: ball_scrape
ball_scrape.note: the ball rubbing along a wall: a rub, the wall ringing under it, the shell ticking

rod_slide_slow.name: rod_slide_slow
rod_slide_slow.note: a rod sliding gently: the bushing hush, the steel tube ringing now and then

rod_slide_fast.name: rod_slide_fast
rod_slide_fast.note: a rod jerked hard: louder hush, the tube rattling, the men clattering on it

rod_spin.name: rod_spin
rod_spin.note: a rod turning fast: the men cutting the air twice a turn, the rod rattling

rod_bump.name: rod_bump
rod_bump.note: a rod hitting its end stop: the rubber bumper, the cabinet thud, a little ring of the rod
